name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
des: The Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities is a state government scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance (SJSA), Government of Maharashtra, through the MahaDBT portal. It provides comprehensive financial assistance — including tuition fees, examination fees, and monthly maintenance allowance — to students with 40% or more disability pursuing post-matric education from Class 11 up to PhD level. The scheme covers ALL categories of students regardless of caste/religion — Open, OBC, SC, ST, SEBC, Minority — as long as the student has a certified physical disability of 40% or above. MBA falls under Group A (Management/Business/Finance Administration courses), which carries the highest maintenance allowance. Income limit is ₹2,50,000 per annum. No other concurrent scholarship is allowed except the Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship. Benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank account. Applications for A.Y. 2025–26 are open until 30 June 2026.
benefits: MBA falls under Group A — Monthly Maintenance Allowance: Hostellers ₹1,200/month, Day Scholars ₹550/month (for max 10 months)
100% reimbursement of all mandatory compulsory fees — Tuition Fees, Examination Fees, and other compulsory payable fees
Group A failure rule: If student fails 1st time, scholarship may continue; if fails 2nd time during entire course duration, scholarship cancelled
Blind students — Additional Vachak Bhatta: Group A, B, C ₹100/month, Group D ₹75/month, Group E ₹50/month
Hearing Impaired students — Transportation Allowance up to ₹100/month (for students residing outside hostel campus)
Locomotor Disability — Transportation Allowance up to ₹100/month
Mental Retardation/Mental Illness — Transportation ₹100/month + Escort Allowance ₹100/month + Special Pay ₹100/month + Extra Coaching ₹150/month
Government hostellers not receiving books/stationery from hostel eligible for additional 1/3rd of hosteller maintenance allowance
Distance education students: ₹500/annum for books and material purchase (non-refundable fees covered separately)
MPhil and PhD students: maintenance allowance at postgraduate Group A, B, C rates
Project typing expense up to ₹600/annum for students
Scholarship covers full duration of course via DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank account
criteria: Student must have a physical disability of 40% or above — certified by a government medical board or competent authority
Disability Certificate must be issued by a government-authorized medical authority — private hospital certificates NOT accepted
Student must be a permanent resident/domicile of Maharashtra
Annual parental/guardian income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 from all sources
Employed students: income of student combined with parents must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (eligible for fee reimbursement only)
Must be studying in a government-recognized university or institution in Maharashtra (or outside Maharashtra if domicile of Maharashtra)
For MBA: admission through MAH-MBA CET CAP round — management quota admissions not mentioned as restriction but CAP-admitted students are clearly covered
MBA (Management/Business/Finance Administration) falls under Group A — highest benefit slab
Scholarship applicable only once per stage: progressive format — e.g., after completing UG, PG MBA is a new eligible course
If student fails or withdraws from the course applied for (Group B/C/D/E), scholarship cancelled for that course
For Group A (MBA): 1 failure allowed; 2nd failure = permanent cancellation of scholarship
Full-time employed students are NOT eligible
Can only apply for Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship concurrently — no other scholarship allowed simultaneously
required_documents: Disability Certificate issued by government-authorized medical authority (must specify type and percentage of disability — minimum 40%)
Annual Income Certificate from Tehsildar/SDO (parental income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh)
CAP Allotment Letter (for MBA admitted through MAH-MBA CET CAP round)
Admission Receipt / Tuition Fee Receipt for current academic year
Bonafide Certificate from the MBA institute
Hostel Certificate (if staying in hostel — for hosteller maintenance rate)
Self-Declaration that student is not receiving any other government scholarship (except Rajarshi Merit Scholarship)
application_process: Click 'New Applicant Registration' and register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete Applicant Profile with personal, academic, disability, and bank details
Navigate to 'Social Justice & Special Assistance Department' schemes list
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship for Persons with Disability' and click Apply
Select Course Group A for MBA (Management/Business/Finance Administration courses)
Fill in disability details, MBA institute details, CAP allotment information, and hostel/day scholar status accurately
Upload Disability Certificate, Income Certificate, and all required documents in JPG/PDF format
Review all details carefully and submit the application
Note Application ID and track real-time status via Granular Application Tracking on MahaDBT portal
Ensure institute principal verifies your application on MahaDBT — unverified applications are rejected
Applications for A.Y. 2025–26 open until 30 June 2026; re-apply for A.Y. 2023–24 and 2024–25 also valid until 30 June 2026
